description: Reject one planned Autopilot post. The first call returns the exact post and expectedActionHash as a preview; show it, then confirm the unchanged actionId and expectedActionHash with confirm:true and a stable clientRequestId. Rejection uses the app refund/replacement route (any eligible refund settles once) and can incur ordinary replacement planning cost, disclosed before confirmation; it never falls back to skipping. Needs manage:autopilot. After uncertainty read soclo_autopilot_get_draft with the original actionId and reconcile; never repeat the write or create a replacement.
name: soclo_autopilot_reject_draft
title: Reject a planned Autopilot post
